Weekly digest returns str(d['_id']) for announcements — good, no ObjectId leakage observed. Confirmed no _id leakage in payload.
AttachmentGallery embeds attachments as data: URLs which balloons DOM/base64 for many images; fine for MVP but worth converting to blob URLs in future.
